summary: Part 3 (09:50-13:49) of the Seller Onboarding App walkthrough. The trainer reads Revibe's quality guidelines (a Google Drive PDF, pages 2-4 of 6: phones, tablets and watches, then laptops), fills in the seller onboarding form in the AppSheet 'Seller Onboarding App' (quality-guidelines answer, DHL account, tax registration certificate, trading license and number, Emirates ID, position, bank details), then shows the application status and the three approval outcomes (Incomplete, Rejected, Accepted) and what happens next for each. The Yes click and the Save press are not on any frame; the open form already shows Application submitted by 11:45. All 40 frames listed in the pack were opened (t00780 and t00817 re-read to confirm). Test values (123456, random PDFs, 'XXX') were typed by the trainer and are not rules.
